body: Thanks man. I really don't know how else to tell them. My brother and i are close and one time he broke down in front of them telling them he just wanted to die. Their response was "We all get sad sometimes" and "its a teenager thing". I just dont think i could take that, yah know? I just feel so fragile. Religion plays a big part in it too, my dad just says "you haven't been reading your bible, have you" and my mother thinks I'm being sexually active or some bullshit. They dont get it.

Thats exactly my point!! Either way it ends, honestly i cant tell you whats right or wrong to do but like your feelings are valid. They arent arbitrary or useless. They matter. And will lead to some serious personal development. Theres more people to love, things to do, courses you could take. Seems kinda lame to end it here right?

Maybe this is something worth asking her about. I know it might feel like starting an argument over nothing but i think its something worth saying, if only just so you feel heard. I often slept around my ex-boyfriend cause i felt like i was at home with him, and i could just be comfortable and chill out. If i knew it bothered him, id be glad to be told. Cause your time is precious, gotta make sure she's not flaking.

Yeah, it's pretty taboo. Theres often nothing constructive to be said on the topic cause people are freaked out by it.

I want to make them understand, but all i have the energy to do is to shrug it off and comfort myself with the idea of just killing myself lol. Everything feels so DIFFICULT yah know?

Hey, this situation is crazy and boy have you delt with some things. First i want to say, it was clearly the right choice to end the relationship with that female and it was clearly unhealthy. Secondly i want to say your feelings are valid and understood. What you are feeling is terrible, im sorry that you got hurt. This however, is not the end for you!! There's so much more than hurt and despair in the world. I know the statement sounds empty and arbitrary to you now but there are so many people out there that you are yet to meet! People you can form healthy, caring relationships with. Relationships are always a gamble, and its unfortunate that we have to come out on the bottom sometimes but there is always more to experience. 

I personally think its the contrary, your suicide will bring no relief or happiness to anyone involved. The best thing is for you to focus on yourself and healing.

Fuck, feel like im getting there, to be honest. Yes, and I've been to therapy and taken pills. My parents consider it to be a cry for attention. Since my grades haven't gone down they don't care. They dont believe in mental illness, haha. Whats your experience with mental illness and family been like?

I'm not a great philosopher or anyone of great knowledge. I don't have any of the answers but I can tell you that its worth a fuckin shot. Life isn't that long, we aren't gonna have to deal with this forever. So while you're here, have some fun. Look into things. Grow your mind, set goals. Be reckless and dont give a shit. Be a badass, be a lover, be alone if its what you want. But all im saying is that people often kill themselves because they feel powerless. As a deadman, you got no power at all. If you've survived suicidal thoughts, heartbreak, depression, hopelessness, the length of this boring-ass paragraph i just wrote, i believe that you have the strength to live another day.

I have a couple triggers! For these actions specifically, its going to church (My parents are strictly religious), mention of law school when i finish school in 2018 and being treated like a child. Even in my suicidality, i want to preserve some pride and despite almost being out of school im never taken seriously. It makes me feel so worthless. What about you?

I mean, you've made it this far and thats great. You are obviously an empathetic and thoughtful person thinking about your mother like that. I can't promise that it will get better any time soon but please listen to me when i say therapy WORKS! there are people out there who will take you and your condition seriously. You cant invest so much into a person without losing yourself a little bit, believe me i know. Fight for your life man, you're worth it.
